title: Analytics for Linguistically Characterising Rephrased Arguments
abstract:
This demo paper presents a platform designed to process changes of
ethotic and sentiment load in argumentation when speakers rephrase what has been said. Our aim is to produce a linguistic analysis and a linguistic model from corpus analysis with the ultimate goal of the development of a natural language system which is capable of identifying the facets of rephrase.
keywords:
rephrased arguments, ethos and sentiment, linguistic analysis, analytics
technology
